description_en: Creates a local recording upload task
description_zh: 调用该接口用于创建本地录像上传任务
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual create-local-file-upload-job --time-slot IotId=d7XmBoJhAr88C6PelXDF000000 EndTime=1631019775 StartTime=1631019675 ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=camera1 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLocalFileUploadJob

fields.help_en:
The name of the video device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
fields.name: device_name

fields.help_en:
The end time of the local recording to upload. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The maximum time range for a single local recording upload task is 1 hour
fields.help_zh:
上传本地录像的结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。
单次本地录像上传任务的最大时间范围为1小时
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The ID of the video device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
fields.name: iot_id

fields.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information of all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
fields.name: product_key

fields.help_en:
The start time of the local recording to upload. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The maximum time range for a single local recording upload task is 1 hour
fields.help_zh:
上传本地录像的开始时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。
单次本地录像上传任务的最大时间范围为1小时
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

JobId.description_en:
The ID of the local recording upload node.
Keep the JobId safe. After the recording upload node is complete, use the JobId to query the task result of the local recording upload node: [QueryLocalFileUploadJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363004.html）. You can also use the JobId to stop the local recording upload node as needed: [DeleteLocalFileUploadJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363003.html）
JobId.description_zh:
本地录像上传任务ID。
请您妥善保存JobId。录像上传任务完成后，需使用JobId查询本地录像上传任务结果：[QueryLocalFileUploadJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363004.html）。您也可以根据需要， 使用JobId停止本地录像上传任务：[DeleteLocalFileUploadJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363003.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
